3. Light cigarettes are safer – Light cigarettes still contain the same amount of nicotine and other harmful chemicals as regular cigarettes, so they are equally as dangerous.

4. Smokeless tobacco is less hazardous than cigarettes – Smokeless tobacco is still addictive, contains many carcinogens, and can lead to oral cancer.

5. People will eventually quit smoking eventually – Many people think that if you smoke long enough, you will eventually be able to quit on your own. In reality, this is not the case; most people need help quitting or switching to other forms of nicotine products.

instruction: Describe how a Docker container works.
output: A Docker container is an isolated environment in which applications can be packaged and run. It consists of the application, system libraries, and other configuration files necessary for a specific task. The container runs within a docker host, which isolates the container from other host resources and is responsible for managing its life cycle. Docker containers are lightweight and highly portable; they can be quickly spun up and transported to different environments such as cloud, bare metal, and on-premises. Containers are isolated from the underlying host system so they can be securely run and managed. Docker also uses images which function like snapshots – making it easy to deploy and run applications reliably and consistently across different environments.

Additionally, since open source relies heavily on the community, it may be difficult to determine who is responsible in the case of an issue with the software. Finally, since users can modify the code, it can lead to different versions of the same software, making it difficult to update and maintain the software.
